```csharp
// tests/Invariants/CachingInvariants.cs (Human-Written)
using Xunit;

public class CachingInvariants : IClassFixture<TestWebApplicationFactory>
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Test_Invariant_Strict_Tenant_Isolation()
    {
        /*
         * INVARIANT: It must be mathematically impossible for User B 
         * to retrieve a cache payload generated by User A.
         */
         
        // 1. User A generates a cache payload
        var responseA = await _clientA.GetAsync("/api/v1/transactions?limit=10");
        responseA.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

        // 2. User B executes the exact same query parameters
        var responseB = await _clientB.GetAsync("/api/v1/transactions?limit=10");
        responseB.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

        // 3. VERIFY INVARIANT: The data must differ. User B must not see User A's data.
        // If the cache is insecurely hashing just the query string, this assertion will fail.
        var dataA = await responseA.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        var dataB = await responseB.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        Assert.NotEqual(dataA, dataB); // INVARIANT BREACH: Cross-tenant data exposure detected.
    }
}
```
